title: Stability under product and composition for uniform Carleman asymptotic expansions
summary: We study the stability under point-wise product and under composition in Carleman classes of holomorphic functions, defined on sectors of the Riemann surface of the logarithm, and admitting a uniform asymptotic expansion with remainders controlled by a given sequence of positive real numbers $\mathbf{M}$. On the one hand, the well-known conditions of algebrability and Faà di Bruno, imposed on the sequence $\mathbf{M}$, ensure the desired stability with respect to each operation in both the Roumieu and the Beurling settings.
